system.notes:
Knight Errant's King County Armed Security real-time dispatch host. Patrol positioning, armed response allocation, and active incident management. A decker who can read this has a live map of where KE is — and isn't.

Notable data: Patrol routes, response time estimates by district, personnel assignments, ongoing incident reports. Invaluable for planning any run in KE-protected territory.

nodes.name: System Access Node
nodes.description: Hardened gateway. KE officer credentials required. Unrecognised connections are immediately flagged and IC deployed — KE does not wait.

nodes.name: I/O Port
nodes.description: Dispatch centre hardlines. Located inside KE King County HQ, which is itself a hardened facility. Getting to this jackpoint is half the challenge.

nodes.name: Sub-Processing Unit
nodes.description: Routes real-time dispatch data, patrol positioning updates, and incident escalation flags.

nodes.name: Data Store
nodes.description: Patrol route schedules, response time logs, personnel assignments, active incident files, and KE client contracts. The motherlode for planning a run in KE territory.

nodes.name: Slave Node
nodes.description: Controls KE patrol vehicle transponders, response drone positioning, and facility access locks across all contracted client sites.

nodes.name: Central Processing Unit
nodes.description: Administers the dispatch system, officer credentials, and the encrypted client contract database. The only node with full read access to all patrol data.

ioPorts.name: KE HQ Dispatch Hardlines
ioPorts.physicalLocation: KE King County HQ dispatch floor. The building itself is a rated security facility — armed guards, biometric entry, and roving patrols. The jackpoints are at the dispatcher workstations on the secure floor.

triggerSteps.label: TS 1
triggerSteps.description: Immediate dual response. Alert (Passive) logs the access event; Authenticator challenges credentials simultaneously. KE maintains a 24/7 matrix monitoring team — a human sysop is reviewing this within 60 seconds.

triggerSteps.label: TS 2
triggerSteps.description: Tracker deploys. Live feed to the duty matrix officer. Every node the decker enters is logged. KE will use this to build a threat profile even if the decker escapes.

triggerSteps.label: TS 3
triggerSteps.description: Blaster launches. KE IC is combat-rated — this is an Overload attack, Moderate damage. Duty officer has authorised aggressive countermeasures.

triggerSteps.label: TS 4
triggerSteps.description: Sparky activates. Disrupts Matrix-connected equipment — decks, commlinks, and cyberware with Matrix interfaces may suffer temporary glitches (GM discretion). Particularly nasty against heavily augmented deckers.

triggerSteps.label: TS 5
triggerSteps.description: Hydra deploys. Multiple attack vectors simultaneously — one instance per active node the intruder has accessed. If the decker is spread across the host, they're fighting on multiple fronts.

triggerSteps.label: TS 6
triggerSteps.description: Active Alert. All KE patrols within 3km redirected to probable physical location. Drone assets repositioned. SN begins broadcasting the intruder's estimated physical zone to all units.

triggerSteps.label: TS 7
triggerSteps.description: DS locked down completely. SN control authority transferred to armed response team command. The patrol data the decker came for is now inaccessible.

triggerSteps.label: TS 8
triggerSteps.description: Full lockdown. Host switches to emergency-only mode. CPU severs all non-essential connections. KE armed response team is 2 minutes out from the I/O jackpoint location.

triggerSteps.label: TS 9
triggerSteps.description: Convergence. GOD response. KE records the decker's matrix signature for future identification. Physical arrest team on-site. KE will remember this face.
